content: The algorithm identifier for RSA keys shall have the value 1.2.840.113549.1.1.1. This corresponds to the ASN.1 coded OID value “2A 86 48 86 F7 0D 01 01 01”. This OID shall be provided whenever an AlgorithmIdent ifier for RSA is required. In other words, when a key has the format CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN_IDENT_PRIVATEKEY_ PKCS8 or CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN_IDENT_PUBLICKEY and is used for RSA, the AlgorithmIdentifier must have this value. Note: In some cases, a NULL value i s followed directly to the OID. So, a value that follows directly after this OID in the same sequence is optional and should be tolerated.
